messages:
Jordan: Heads-up: pushing start to 10:05 PT (5 min) to fold in a brief hiring update from People. Also shifting roadmap Q&A to after demos. Recording will be live — pls do quick mic/video checks when asked.
Priya: thanks. can we add a 3-min buffer after leadership for live Qs? last time we ran over.
Jordan: yes, adding 3-min buffer. leadership update -> demos -> short break -> roadmap Q&A.
Carlos: small ask: can infra do a 1-slide latency status during leadership? 30s max.
Maya: noted, I'll prep that slide.
Jordan: @StreamBot run preflight and confirm captions.
StreamBot: Preflight: OK. Captions: ON. Recording target: s3://redwood-recordings/all-hands/1769010000.mp4. Backup bitrate ready.
Ben: mic/video check in 3: I'll say "Redwood mic check" once.
Lila: captions were off last time for the mobile demo, can we validate during the prestream?
OpsBot: captions confirmed ON at 10:03:12. CDN edges healthy. No key rotations.
StreamBot: Recording started. viewers: 8 (pre).
Maya: switching to demo scene in 3...
Ben: seeing a caption delay ~6s on the prestream preview. is that expected?
OpsBot: small TTL propagation on captions for edge A (us-west-2) ~6s. global viewers shouldn't see >2s. continuing to monitor.
Carlos: leadership asked for a clarification on model rollout priority (latency vs cost). can we queue that for Q&A?
Jordan: yes. @Priya will kick off the leadership segment with that note.
Priya: launching now.
StreamBot: Live viewers: 120. Reaction: :clap:.
Maya: during the mobile demo my screen share lost audio for ~10s at 10:12. saw OBS error: `obs_source_get_audio` repeated.
Ben: I can confirm a micro-drop on my end, maybe desktop audio unmuted briefly.
Jordan: Ops, track that. We need raw audio export in case editor needs to fix.
OpsBot: raw + mix exports enabled. marking 10:12 - 10:13 clip for editor.
Lila: captions just blinked off for ~4s at 10:14:05. viewers in eu reported no captions.
StreamBot: Captions service restarted at 10:14:09. Restart triggered failover to captions-backend-2.
Priya: ugh. sorry for the hiccup. should we pause to re-sync transcript?
Jordan: don't pause the stream. keep going. we will note it in the recording and post the corrected transcript.
Carlos: Q for leadership (from chat): will dedicated capacity plans include smaller GPU sizes for lower bursty workloads?
Jordan: short answer: yes, roadmap item. we'll publish details next week. leaving time for 2 live q's after demos.
Maya: demo finished. handing back to roadmap.
StreamBot: Recording stopped. Uploading file: all-hands-1769010000.mp4.
OpsBot: Upload complete. Transcode 1080p + captions. Captioned VTT and corrected transcript will be available after postprocess.
Ben: thanks all. i'll take any follow-ups about demo audio into the #eng-qa thread.
Lila: adding the caption gap and audio marker to the edit checklist.
Jordan: big thanks. we'll follow up with the detailed roadmap doc and a short retro for stream ops tomorrow. Please add any post-meeting action items to the retro board.
